results.title: Toxic advance booking: Yash-starrer pre-sales cross Rs 27 crore, set to release on August 26
results.description: Advance bookings for Yash’s upcoming action thriller Toxic have crossed Rs 27 Crore across India, setting up a potentially record-breaking opening on August 26, 2026.
